name: Hammered Shoulder
description: Drive the tempered shoulder through the target's guard with a short heavy step.

name: Frame Clamp
description: Lock spine and hips and knees into one rigid line to take a heavy blow whole.

name: Gliding Foot
description: Skate the lead foot across the ground in a low glide that closes distance without a hop.

name: Fanning Elbow
description: Swing the elbow in a flat arc across the target's jaw as the body turns behind it.

name: Furnace Draw
description: Pull a long breath to the belly and let qi spread warm through the limbs for stronger blows.

name: Flank Cover
description: Drop the elbow over the ribs and turn a side blow away along the arm.

name: Frame Crash
description: Throw the whole tempered frame into the target so it staggers and its guard breaks open.

name: Hardened Weave
description: Hold qi taut through skin and muscle so blows glance off and each parry steadies your next strike.

name: Muscle Cushion
description: Turn the thick of the thigh or arm to the blow and let the muscle swallow its force.

name: Rebounding Fist
description: Take a blow on the guard and throw a fist back along the same line.

name: Brow Knock
description: Snap the forehead into the bridge of the target's nose from a close clinch.

name: Bruise Pack
description: Press warm qi into deep bruising on yourself or an ally until the swelling goes down.

name: Gut Tighten
description: Clench the belly and breathe out sharply at the instant a blow lands on the middle.

name: Brace Drift
description: Let a blow push you back along a straight line and use the slide to keep your feet.

name: Pain Return
description: Set the body so a blow on it sends a share of its force back through the striker's own arm.

name: Marrow Steel
description: Run qi through the bones until they ring hard so the frame takes blows that would crack it.

name: Shock Swallow
description: Drop low at the moment of impact and let the legs spread a heavy blow into the ground.

name: Lashing Arm
description: Loosen the arm and whip it out from the shoulder so the hand lands like a cord.

name: Tendon Spring
description: Coil the heel tendon and release it into a quick leap sideways.

name: Wrist Flick
description: Snap the wrist at the end of a reach so the knuckles rap the target's eyes.

name: Sinew Stretch
description: Draw out a shortened tendon of yourself or an ally with slow pulling and warm qi.

name: Cord Guard
description: Flick the loose forearm against an incoming strike and send it wide.

name: Whiplash Rake
description: Rake the whipping arm down the target's front in three quick lashes before it can guard.

name: Pivoting Cord
description: Spin on the ball of the foot and carry the turn into a lashing blow at the target's flank.

name: Kindling Breath
description: Take short sharp breaths until the body warms and qi races in the muscles for the coming fight.

name: Furnace Fist
description: Throw a heated fist from the hip so the blow lands with the full warmth of the body.

name: Heat Wrap
description: Wrap the trunk in a layer of body heat that softens the first strike against it.

name: Sweat Out
description: Open the pores with heat and sweat out fatigue and light chills from yourself or an ally.

name: Exhale Stride
description: Exhale hard and stride on the breath so the leg strikes the ground already moving.

name: Chest Hammer
description: Slam the flat of the shoulder and chest into the target after a full inhale.

name: Heated Shrug
description: Throw a rolling shrug of hot qi across the shoulder to turn a glancing cut aside.

name: Humour Purge
description: Drive qi and heat through the blood to sweat out mild poison or foul humours from yourself or an ally.

name: Forge Surge
description: Flare the furnace breath at once so your next blow lands with a surge of heat and strength.

name: Burning Rebuke
description: Knock a blow aside with a burning forearm and answer with a short heated strike.

name: Fibre Mend
description: Hold both hands over torn muscle of yourself or an ally while warm qi draws the fibres together.

name: Bone Splint
description: Brace a cracked bone with the hands and fix it straight with a steady flow of qi.

name: Healer's Step
description: Cross open ground in quick sure steps that keep the shoulders level and the hands free.

name: Reading Hands
description: Run still hands along a body to feel where bone has cracked or muscle has torn.

name: Poison Pull
description: Pull poison out through a bite or cut with a pulse of qi and a firm press on the vein.

name: Wound Closing
description: Draw the edges of a deep cut of yourself or an ally together and seal them with qi.

name: Wrist Lock
description: Seize the target's wrist and turn it against the joint until the hand opens.

name: Elbow Lever
description: Straighten the target's arm against your chest and press the elbow against its bend.

name: Sleeve Drag
description: Pull the target's arm across its body to spoil its stance and open its flank.

name: Squat Guard
description: Drop into a low squat with the arms crossed to keep a grabber off your hips.

name: Throat Hook
description: Hook the edge of the hand against the target's throat to stop its breath for a moment.

name: Pivot Roll
description: Roll over the shoulder out of a hold and come up facing the foe.

name: Shoulder Wrench
description: Twist the target's arm up behind its back and wrench the shoulder to the edge of failing.

name: Knee Break
description: Stamp the side of the target's knee so the leg gives and the whole body drops.

name: Chain Clinch
description: Wrap arms and legs round the target in a locked clinch and tighten with each of its struggles.

name: Bull Rush
description: Lower the head and drive forward with the legs to carry the target backward.

name: Thigh Drive
description: Pump the thighs in a flat run that gains speed in three strides.

name: Collision Guard
description: Tuck the chin and turn the shoulder to meet a rival rush as it lands.

name: Skip Angle
description: Skip off one foot and land on the other at an angle to change the line of the run.

name: Haunch Shove
description: Hit the target's hip with yours at the end of the rush to break its stance.

name: Runner's Lungs
description: Open the chest and breathe qi into the legs so the run holds its pace.

name: Battering Frame
description: Hurl the whole body forward at full run into the target's guard and break it with the weight.

name: Skid Turn
description: Skid on the sole at the end of a run and swing the shoulder round into the target.

name: Stance Weighing
description: Watch how the target stands and judge which foot bears its weight and which blow it will throw.

name: Shoulder Tell
description: Catch the small lift of the target's shoulder that comes before a strike.

name: Forward Slip
description: Slide off the line of the coming blow a breath before it lands.

name: Answering Palm
description: Meet the blow with an open palm placed where it will land and turn it away.

name: Gap Jab
description: Strike into the opening a foe leaves as it shifts its weight.

name: Fatigue Reading
description: Judge from breath and gait how close an ally or foe is to the end of its strength.

name: Tension Break
description: Jab the muscle of the target's arm where it is clenched and spoil the force it was gathering.

name: Forestalling Strike
description: Read the tension in the target's shoulders and land a blow just as the target begins to move.

name: Reflex Cover
description: Feel the shift of weight and place the guard before the blow is thrown.

name: Tangle Counter
description: Catch the striking limb in a hooked guard and tangle the arm so the foe cannot withdraw.
